tools.name: set_project_root
tools.description: Explicitly set the target project root directory. Use this as a fallback if playwright.config.* cannot be automatically discovered by other tools.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the target project root, e.g. "/home/user/my-app".

tools.name: init_qa_project
tools.description: Create a standalone Playwright automation repository for QA (separate from the frontend repo): package.json, playwright.config.ts, tsconfig, .env/.env.example (BASE_URL, API_URL, ID_SELECTOR, TEST_USER, TEST_PASSWORD), .gitignore, docs/test-case/ (test case files) and assets/ (files for uploads), plus tests/e2e/support helpers. Existing files are skipped unless overwrite is true, and .env is never overwritten. The new project becomes the active project root.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the new (or existing) QA automation repository. The folder is created when it does not exist.

projectName.description: npm package name. Defaults to the folder name.

baseUrl.description: Target website URL written to BASE_URL, e.g. "https://staging.example.com".

apiUrl.description: Backend API URL written to API_URL.

idSelector.description: Custom selector attribute suffix written to ID_SELECTOR, e.g. "cy" for data-cy. Optional.

overwrite.description: Overwrite existing generated files. The .env file is never overwritten. Default: false.

tools.name: inspect_page
tools.description: Open a page of the application under test (BASE_URL from .env) in a headless browser using the project's own Playwright and return the elements a test needs: role, accessible name and the BEST locator per element, chosen in this order: data-testid > data-qa > data-{ID_SELECTOR} > role+name > label > placeholder > text. Use it instead of reading frontend source code. 'steps' (click/fill/select/press/waitFor/snapshot) reach other UI states such as modals or wizard steps; useAuth reuses the saved login session; credentials can be typed with {{TEST_USER}}/{{TEST_PASSWORD}} and are redacted from the output. Navigation is limited to BASE_URL/API_URL origins (plus allowedOrigins). Locators that match several elements are flagged ambiguous: scope them in a container instead of using .nth().

url.description: Page to inspect: a path relative to BASE_URL (e.g. "/login") or a full URL on an allowed origin. Default: "/".
URL or path (relative to BASE_URL) on an allowed origin.

target.description: Playwright selector, e.g. role=button[name="Login"], [data-qa="submit"] or text=Sign in.

value.description: Text to enter. Use {{TEST_USER}} / {{TEST_PASSWORD}} to take credentials from .env; they are never returned.

label.description: Name of the state to capture, e.g. "login error".

steps.description: Actions to reach other UI states (open a modal, fill a form, next wizard step). A state is captured at the start, after each 'snapshot' step, at the end, and where a step fails.

useAuth.description: Reuse the saved login session (.auth/user.json from scaffold_auth_setup) for pages behind login. Default: false.

maxElements.description: Maximum elements listed per state. Default: 60.

includeAriaSnapshot.description: Include a truncated ARIA snapshot per state (Playwright 1.49+). Default: true.

allowedOrigins.description: Extra origins navigation may reach (e.g. a login provider). BASE_URL and API_URL are always allowed.

projectRoot.description: Optional path to the QA project root. Auto-detected if omitted.

tools.name: read_test_cases
tools.description: Read the test case files QA put in docs/test-case/ (Gherkin .feature, .csv, optional .xlsx) and return structured cases: id, title, feature, priority, tags, preconditions, steps, expected results, with source file and line/row. Read-only and limited to docs/test-case/. Use it BEFORE inspecting the website and generating tests; keep the case id (e.g. TC-001) as a tag in the generated test title. Filter with ids or path to save tokens.

path.description: Optional file or sub-folder inside docs/test-case/ (e.g. "docs/test-case/login.feature"). Default: the whole folder.

ids.description: Only return these test case IDs (e.g. ["TC-001"]).

maxCases.description: Maximum number of test cases returned. Default: 200.

includeExamples.description: Also read files named example.* (the samples created by init_qa_project). Default: false.

projectRoot.description: Optional path to the target project root. Auto-detected if omitted.

tools.name: scaffold_auth_setup
tools.description: Create the global authentication handler: tests/e2e/auth (config, page object or API helper, auth.setup.ts) that logs in once with TEST_USER/TEST_PASSWORD from .env and saves the session to .auth/user.json, then wires a 'setup' project with storageState and dependencies into playwright.config.* (when it is the standard QA config) and git-ignores .auth/. mode 'ui' (default) logs in through the form; mode 'api' logs in with the backend API. scaffold_test_domain calls this automatically for auth-like features.

mode.description: 'ui' (default) logs in through the login form; 'api' logs in with the backend API (cookies). Both save the session to .auth/user.json.

loginPath.description: Login page path for mode 'ui'. Default: /login.

apiLoginPath.description: Login endpoint path (relative to API_URL) for mode 'api'. Default: /api/v1/auth/login.

projectRoot.description: Optional path to the target project root. Auto-detected if omitted.

overwrite.description: Overwrite existing auth files. Default: false.

tools.name: scaffold_test_domain
tools.description: Scaffold the Domain-Driven POM structure for a feature: pages, mock API handlers, real API helpers, custom fixture, dynamic data factory and a spec, plus a shared diagnostics fixture (tests/e2e/support) that records browser console/page/network events. The spec is an explicit skeleton: its tests are test.fixme (skipped) and marked @mcp-skeleton until the TODOs are implemented. Always use this before writing new tests to ensure a consistent structure.

featureName.description: Name of the domain feature in kebab-case or camelCase, e.g. "auth", "checkout", or "user-profile" (max 64 characters).

steps.description: Optional list of step/page names for this feature, e.g. ["email", "otp", "password"]. Defaults to [featureName].

projectRoot.description: Optional path to target project root. Auto-detected if omitted.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files if they already exist. Default: false.

testTypes.description: Which reference example tests to put in the spec. Default: all four (smoke, ui, regression, integration).

apiBasePath.description: API path of the feature used by the mock and api helpers, e.g. "/api/v1/orders". Default: /api/v1/{featureName}.

withAuthSetup.description: For auth-like features (name contains auth, login, logout, register, signin or signup) also create the global auth handler (scaffold_auth_setup, UI mode). Default: true. Pass false to skip.

tools.name: run_playwright_test
tools.description: Run Playwright tests in the target project (pass a spec file, a directory, or omit specPath and pass grep for tag-only runs like @smoke or @regression) and return a bounded, structured result: explicit status, counts, runner/process metadata, up to 5 failures with location, error type, recent steps, browser console errors, page errors and failed requests (from trace.zip and/or the scaffolded diagnostics fixture), screenshot/trace/video/error-context paths, and a compact qualityScore. The project's own reporters keep running, and Allure reports (allure-report/index.html) are automatically compiled when Allure is configured in the project. Use detail:'full' or get_failure_details for more. TOKEN ECONOMY INSTRUCTION: In your response, provide a clean, compact 2–3 line summary (status, duration, video link, and failure cause) rather than dumping large markdown tables into chat. If tests fail, analyze the error and formulate a concrete fix proposal in '.page.ts'. To confirm with the user before applying fixes: 1) If an interactive question/selection tool is available in your environment (e.g. ask_question, vscode_askQuestions), MUST use it to present options: ['Apply Fix & Re-run', 'Review Diff First', 'Cancel']. 2) Otherwise, present the options as a clean numbered list in your response so the user can easily reply with just the number.

specPath.description: Optional path to a spec file or directory, relative to project root or absolute, e.g. "e2e/payment.spec.ts" or "tests/e2e/specs". If omitted, runs all tests or tests matching `grep` across the project (e.g. grep: "@smoke" or "@regression").

projectRoot.description: Optional path to the target project root. If omitted, auto-detected by searching for playwright.config.*.

grep.description: Only run tests whose title matches this pattern (passed to --grep).

headed.description: Run in headed (visible browser) mode instead of headless.

generateHtmlReport.description: Set to true to generate the standalone visual quality report at test-results/quality-report.html.

generateAllureReport.description: Explicitly enable or disable auto-generating the Allure report (allure-report/index.html) after the test run. If omitted, auto-generation runs automatically whenever Allure is configured in the project and the local Allure CLI is available.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum runner duration in milliseconds (default 120000; allowed range 100–900000).

detail.description: Response size. 'summary' (default) returns status, counts, up to 5 failures with bounded diagnostics and artifact paths. 'full' adds every test with retry attempts, runner stdout/stderr and the complete quality score. Prefer get_failure_details for one test.

tools.name: check_test_prerequisites
tools.description: Read-only preflight check for a target project. Detects the local (or workspace-hoisted) Playwright package, CLI, config, browser builds matching the installed Playwright version, branded channels, optional Allure adapter/CLI readiness and setup guide, and report artifacts — without installing packages or downloading browsers.

projectRoot.description: Optional path to the target project root. Auto-detected if omitted.

tools.name: get_failure_details
tools.description: Get the full diagnostic breakdown for one failing test from a previous run_playwright_test report: exact location, recent steps, call log, browser console errors, page errors, failed requests, and screenshot/trace/video/error-context paths. Pass testId when titles repeat (e.g. the same spec in several projects).

reportPath.description: The `reportPath` returned by a previous run_playwright_test call for this run.

testTitle.description: Exact title of the failing test, as returned by run_playwright_test.

testId.description: Stable test identity from the run output; required when titles are duplicated (e.g. one spec in several projects).

projectRoot.description: Optional project root used to authorize an in-project report path.

tools.name: score_test_quality
tools.description: Score a spec file and its imported Page Objects with the TypeScript AST (comments and strings are ignored): % semantic locators vs raw CSS/XPath, assertion density, anti-pattern warnings with line numbers, and scaffold skeleton status.

specPath.description: Path to the spec file, page object, or test directory to score, relative to project root or absolute.

projectRoot.description: Optional path to the project root. If omitted, auto-detected by searching for playwright.config.*.

generateHtmlReport.description: Set to true to generate the standalone visual quality report at test-results/quality-report.html.

tools.name: check_playwright_config
tools.description: Statically analyze playwright.config.* (TypeScript AST, not executed) for flakiness-relevant settings (retries, workers, trace, screenshot, video, forbidOnly, fullyParallel) and reporters (HTML/JSON/Allure). Reports whether each value is a literal or a runtime expression. Project-level, not per-spec.

configPath.description: Path to playwright.config.* relative to project root or absolute. If omitted, auto-detected at project root.

projectRoot.description: Optional path to the project root. If omitted, auto-detected.

tools.name: generate_test_report
tools.description: Locate or generate a visual test report. 'quality' and 'html' locate existing reports (the quality dashboard at test-results/quality-report.html; the Playwright HTML report written by the project's html reporter). 'allure' generates allure-report/ from allure-results/ with the local Allure CLI (never downloaded). Returns status: located | generated | not_found | setup_required | generation_failed.

reporter.description: The report to provide: 'quality' (locate test-results/quality-report.html), 'html' (locate the Playwright HTML report written by the project's html reporter), or 'allure' (generate allure-report/ from allure-results/ with the local Allure CLI).

projectRoot.description: Optional path to target project root. Auto-detected if omitted.
